title: How the Classical Baseline Shapes Machine-Learning Speed Claims in Topology Optimization: code and data
description: Audit records, analysis and re-test scripts, run summaries, figure data and Online Resources 1-6 for the paper 'How the Classical Baseline Shapes Machine-Learning Speed Claims in Topology Optimization' (arXiv:2610.16051). Code is released under the MIT licence; records, evidence files, figure data and the Online Resources under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA.md). Third-party code, data and weights are not included.
